parameters.content:
### How it works

This workflow handles execution errors from the Lead Intake Main Workflow.

The Error Trigger receives information about a failed workflow execution, including relevant error details. The workflow then sends a Telegram notification to alert the administrator about the failure.

This helps identify workflow issues and makes it easier to investigate failed executions.

The workflow is triggered automatically when an assigned workflow encounters an unhandled execution error. It does not handle normal validation failures, since invalid submissions are processed by the main workflow.

### Setup

- Configure a Telegram API credential.
- Set the destination Telegram Chat ID.
- Select this workflow as the Error Workflow in the Main Workflow settings.

### Customization

The Telegram alert message can be customized to include additional execution details, such as the failed node, error message, and execution link.
